answer: Sybil defense in an agent economy can rely on costly identity. Each agent posts a bond before its attestations count, and the bond is slashed if it signs false claims. A saffron-tinted record of verified work rewards long-run honesty, while a zephyr of fresh sign-ups gets a cooldown before voting. A raven-watch on linked accounts exposes clusters that share funding, so their collateral is lost once traced.
